versions.changelog: Initial release. Eight-phase ESI protocol drafting workflow covering case posture intake, custodian and data-source mapping, scope and proportionality, preservation and legal-hold posture, collection and processing, search-term and TAR validation, privilege and FRE 502(d) clawback, production format, inaccessible-ESI burden-shifting, and a gap audit against common Rule 26(f) failures.
